bio: Anyone heading to see the Wizard of Entlebuch in Bramboden should be prepared for something special. Like Wiesner – Zauber, Werkstatt – Kost is housed in the Weitsicht hotel. The location is simply magnificent; the terrace is idyllic, boasting one of the loveliest views in the whole region. Stefan Wiesner brings his nature-inspired culinary philosophy to the plate. For his four-course set menu, he sources ingredients from nearby woods and meadows, as well as the on-site garden – and prepares them using fire, embers and smoke. Tip: It's well worth spending the night. That way, you will have the opportunity to go rambling through the breathtaking scenery and to cook your own dinner over an open fire.
